254	/****************************************************************************
255	 * Name: ana_write
256	 *
257	 * Description:
258	 *   Write a value to an analog register and wait for the SPI serial
259	 *   transfer to complete.  Without this the value never takes effect.
260	 *
261	 ****************************************************************************/
262	
263	static void ana_write(uintptr_t addr, uint32_t val)
264	{
265	  uint32_t idx = (addr - ANA_BASE) >> 2;
266	
267	  aud_putreg(val, addr);
268	
269	  while (aud_getreg(ANA_SPI_STATE_REG) & (1u << idx))
270	    {
271	    }
272	}

274	/****************************************************************************
275	 * Name: ana_setbit
276	 *
277	 * Description:
278	 *   Read-modify-write a single bitfield in an analog register via
279	 *   ana_write (with SPI completion poll).
280	 *
281	 ****************************************************************************/
282	
283	static void ana_setbit(uintptr_t addr, int pos, uint32_t val)
284	{
285	  uint32_t r = aud_getreg(addr);
286	
287	  r &= ~(1u << pos);
288	  r |= ((val & 1u) << pos);
289	  ana_write(addr, r);
290	}

296	/****************************************************************************
297	 * Name: audio_init
298	 *
299	 * Description:
300	 *   Initialise BK7258 audio ADC for dual-channel differential capture
301	 *   at 48 kHz.  Sequence from Armino:
302	 *     aud_common_driver.c: bk_aud_driver_init()
303	 *     aud_adc_driver.c:    bk_aud_adc_init()
304	 *     sys_ll.h:            analog SPI write helpers
305	 *
306	 ****************************************************************************/
307	
308	void audio_init(void)
309	{
310	  uint32_t val;
311	
312	  /* ---- Step -1: Audio power domain ----
313	   * cpu_power_sleep_wakeup bit6 pwd_audp: 0 = power on.
314	   * Must be first — without this the audio rail is off and
315	   * nothing else takes effect.
316	   */
317	
318	  val = aud_getreg(SYS_CPU_POWER_SLEEP_WAKEUP);
319	  val &= ~SYS_PWD_AUDP;
320	  aud_putreg(val, SYS_CPU_POWER_SLEEP_WAKEUP);
321	  up_mdelay(2);
322	
323	  syslog(LOG_INFO,
324	         "[mic] PWR: POWER_SLEEP_WAKEUP=0x%08lx\n",
325	         (unsigned long)aud_getreg(SYS_CPU_POWER_SLEEP_WAKEUP));
326	
327	  /* ---- Step 0: SYS audio clock ----
328	   * Must be done BEFORE any AUD 0x478xxxxx register access.
329	   * cksel_aud = 1 (APLL), aud_cken = 1.
330	   * Analog ADC requires APLL; XTAL does not produce sample clocks.
331	   */
332	
333	  val = aud_getreg(SYS_CPU_CLK_DIV_MODE1);
334	  val |= SYS_CKSEL_AUD;
335	  aud_putreg(val, SYS_CPU_CLK_DIV_MODE1);
336	
337	  /* APLL power-on and configuration (from Armino BK7236XX APLL branch) */
338	
339	  ana_setbit(ANA_REG5, 13, 0);          /* pwdaudpll=0: APLL power up */
340	  ana_write(ANA_REG26, 0x8973CA6F);     /* cal_val (16k/48k) */
341	  ana_write(ANA_REG25, 0xC2A0AE86);     /* config */
342	  ana_setbit(ANA_REG25, 18, 1);         /* spi_trigger pulse */
343	  up_mdelay(1);
344	  ana_setbit(ANA_REG25, 18, 0);
345	  up_mdelay(2);                         /* wait for APLL lock */
346	
347	  val = aud_getreg(SYS_CPU_DEVICE_CLK_ENABLE);
348	  val |= SYS_AUD_CKEN;
349	  aud_putreg(val, SYS_CPU_DEVICE_CLK_ENABLE);
350	
351	  syslog(LOG_INFO,
352	         "[mic] SYS aud clock: DIV=0x%08lx CLK=0x%08lx\n",
353	         (unsigned long)aud_getreg(SYS_CPU_CLK_DIV_MODE1),
354	         (unsigned long)aud_getreg(SYS_CPU_DEVICE_CLK_ENABLE));
355	
356	  /* ---- Step 1: AUD digital soft reset ---- */
357	
358	  val = aud_getreg(AUD_CLK_CONTROL);
359	  val &= ~AUD_ADC_CLK_GATE;
360	  aud_putreg(val, AUD_CLK_CONTROL);
361	
362	  val = aud_getreg(AUD_CLK_CONTROL);
363	  val |= AUD_ADC_SOFT_RESET;
364	  aud_putreg(val, AUD_CLK_CONTROL);
365	
366	  /* ---- Step 2: Analog register base values ----
367	   * Must go through analog-SPI (ana_write), NOT raw putreg32.
368	   * These carry trim fields from Armino *_DEFAULT_VAL computation.
369	   */
370	
371	  syslog(LOG_INFO, "[mic] ana: writing base values\n");
372	
373	  ana_write(ANA_REG18, ANA_REG18_BASE);
374	  ana_write(ANA_REG19, ANA_REG19_BASE);
375	  ana_write(ANA_REG20, ANA_REG20_BASE);
376	  ana_write(ANA_REG21, ANA_REG21_BASE);
377	  ana_write(ANA_REG27, ANA_REG27_BASE);
378	
379	  /* ---- Step 3: Enable analog bias + mic enables ----
380	   * Each setbit goes through ana_write with SPI poll.
381	   * Armino: aud_adc_driver.c lines 101-106.
382	   */
383	
384	  syslog(LOG_INFO, "[mic] ana: enable bias + mic1 + mic2\n");
385	
386	  /* audbias / adcbias / micbias on ana_reg18 */
387	
388	  ana_setbit(ANA_REG18, ANA_ENAUDBIAS_BIT, 1);
389	  ana_setbit(ANA_REG18, ANA_ENADCBIAS_BIT, 1);
390	  ana_setbit(ANA_REG18, ANA_ENMICBIAS_BIT, 1);
391	
392	  /* mic1 enable on ana_reg19 bit28 */
393	
394	  ana_setbit(ANA_REG19, ANA_MICEN_BIT, 1);
395	
396	  /* mic2 enable on ana_reg27 bit28.
397	   * (sys_hal_aud_mic2_en is "not support" — write full word.)
398	   */
399	
400	  ana_setbit(ANA_REG27, ANA_MICEN_BIT, 1);
401	
402	  /* Differential mode: ana_reg19 micsingleen=0 (already 0 in base),
403	   * ana_reg20 diffen=1 (already 1 in base).
404	   * No extra writes needed.
405	   */
406	
407	  /* ---- Step 4: MIC reset pulse ---- */
408	
409	  syslog(LOG_INFO, "[mic] ana: mic reset\n");
410	
411	  ana_setbit(ANA_REG19, ANA_MIC_RST_BIT, 1);
412	  up_mdelay(10);
413	  ana_setbit(ANA_REG19, ANA_MIC_RST_BIT, 0);
414	
415	  /* ---- Step 5: ADC digital config ---- */
416	
417	  syslog(LOG_INFO, "[mic] digital: ADC config\n");
418	
419	  val = aud_getreg(AUD_ADC_CONFIG_0);
420	  val &= ~(AUD_ADC_GAIN_MASK | AUD_ADC_EDGE);
421	  val |= AUD_ADC_GAIN_0DB;
422	  val |= AUD_ADC_HPF1_BYP | AUD_ADC_HPF2_BYP;
423	  aud_putreg(val, AUD_ADC_CONFIG_0);
424	
425	  /* ---- Step 6: Sample rate 48kHz, APLL ---- */
426	
427	  val = aud_getreg(AUD_CONFIG);
428	  val &= ~AUD_RATE_ADC_MASK;
429	  val |= AUD_RATE_ADC_48K | AUD_APLL_SEL;
430	  aud_putreg(val, AUD_CONFIG);
431	
432	  val = aud_getreg(AUD_EXTEND_CFG);
433	  val &= ~AUD_ADC_FRAC_MANUAL;
434	  aud_putreg(val, AUD_EXTEND_CFG);
435	
436	  /* ---- Step 7: Enable ADC + analog input path ----
437	   * Armino bk_aud_adc_start: adc_enable and line_enable
438	   * are set together.  line_enable is the analog ADC input
439	   * path enable, NOT an external line-in selector.
440	   */
441	
442	  syslog(LOG_INFO, "[mic] digital: ADC enable\n");
443	
444	  val = aud_getreg(AUD_CONFIG);
445	  val |= AUD_ADC_ENABLE | AUD_LINEIN_ENABLE;
446	  aud_putreg(val, AUD_CONFIG);
447	
448	  up_mdelay(50);
449	
450	  /* Diagnostic readback */
451	
452	  syslog(LOG_INFO,
453	         "[mic] init done. ana_reg readback:\n"
454	         "  reg5=0x%08lx reg25=0x%08lx reg26=0x%08lx\n"
455	         "  reg18=0x%08lx reg19=0x%08lx\n"
456	         "  reg20=0x%08lx reg27=0x%08lx\n"
457	         "  AUD_CONFIG=0x%08lx\n",
458	         (unsigned long)aud_getreg(ANA_REG5),
459	         (unsigned long)aud_getreg(ANA_REG25),
460	         (unsigned long)aud_getreg(ANA_REG26),
461	         (unsigned long)aud_getreg(ANA_REG18),
462	         (unsigned long)aud_getreg(ANA_REG19),
463	         (unsigned long)aud_getreg(ANA_REG20),
464	         (unsigned long)aud_getreg(ANA_REG27),
465	         (unsigned long)aud_getreg(AUD_CONFIG));
466	}

499	/****************************************************************************
500	 * Name: audio_dac_init
501	 *
502	 * Description:
503	 *   Initialise BK7258 internal audio DAC (left channel, differential) for
504	 *   speaker playback.  Reuses the same power/APLL clock and analog-SPI
505	 *   sequence as audio_init(); does NOT enable the ADC/mic.
506	 *   samp_rate: 8000 | 16000 | 48000.
507	 *   Port of Armino bk_aud_dac_init() (aud_dac_driver.c).
508	 ****************************************************************************/
509	
510	void audio_dac_init(int samp_rate)
511	{
512	  uint32_t val;
513	  uint32_t rate_bits;
514	
515	  /* ---- Power domain on ---- */
516	
517	  val = aud_getreg(SYS_CPU_POWER_SLEEP_WAKEUP);
518	  val &= ~SYS_PWD_AUDP;
519	  aud_putreg(val, SYS_CPU_POWER_SLEEP_WAKEUP);
520	  up_mdelay(2);
521	
522	  /* ---- SYS audio clock + APLL (identical to capture) ---- */
523	
524	  val = aud_getreg(SYS_CPU_CLK_DIV_MODE1);
525	  val |= SYS_CKSEL_AUD;
526	  aud_putreg(val, SYS_CPU_CLK_DIV_MODE1);
527	
528	  ana_setbit(ANA_REG5, 13, 0);          /* APLL power up */
529	  ana_write(ANA_REG26, 0x8973CA6F);     /* cal */
530	  ana_write(ANA_REG25, 0xC2A0AE86);     /* config */
531	  ana_setbit(ANA_REG25, 18, 1);         /* spi_trigger pulse */
532	  up_mdelay(1);
533	  ana_setbit(ANA_REG25, 18, 0);
534	  up_mdelay(2);
535	
536	  val = aud_getreg(SYS_CPU_DEVICE_CLK_ENABLE);
537	  val |= SYS_AUD_CKEN;
538	  aud_putreg(val, SYS_CPU_DEVICE_CLK_ENABLE);
539	
540	  /* ---- AUD digital block soft reset (global reset/gate, shared) ---- */
541	
542	  val = aud_getreg(AUD_CLK_CONTROL);
543	  val &= ~AUD_ADC_CLK_GATE;
544	  aud_putreg(val, AUD_CLK_CONTROL);
545	
546	  val = aud_getreg(AUD_CLK_CONTROL);
547	  val |= AUD_ADC_SOFT_RESET;
548	  aud_putreg(val, AUD_CLK_CONTROL);
549	
550	  /* ---- Analog base values (carry trim; diffen + dac bias preset) ---- */
551	
552	  ana_write(ANA_REG18, ANA_REG18_BASE);
553	  ana_write(ANA_REG20, ANA_REG20_BASE);
554	  ana_write(ANA_REG21, ANA_REG21_BASE);
555	
556	  /* ---- DAC analog enables (order per Armino bk_aud_dac_init) ---- */
557	
558	  ana_setbit(ANA_REG21, ANA_DAC_ENBS_BIT,    1);  /* dac bias   */
559	  ana_setbit(ANA_REG20, ANA_DAC_DRVEN_BIT,   1);  /* driver     */
560	  ana_setbit(ANA_REG20, ANA_DAC_LENDCOC_BIT, 1);  /* dcoc       */
561	  ana_setbit(ANA_REG21, ANA_DAC_ENIDACL_BIT, 1);  /* idac       */
562	  ana_setbit(ANA_REG20, ANA_DAC_LEN_BIT,     1);  /* dac left   */
563	  /* diffen (reg20 bit13) already 1 in base → differential output */
564	
565	  /* ---- DAC digital: 0 dB gain, HPF bypass, normal clk edge ---- */
566	
567	  val = aud_getreg(AUD_DAC_CONFIG_0);
568	  val &= ~(AUD_DAC_GAIN_MASK | AUD_DAC_CLK_INVERT);
569	  val |= AUD_DAC_GAIN_0DB | AUD_DAC_HPF1_BYP | AUD_DAC_HPF2_BYP;
570	  aud_putreg(val, AUD_DAC_CONFIG_0);
571	
572	  /* ---- Sample rate (APLL) ---- */
573	
574	  switch (samp_rate)
575	    {
576	      case 8000:  rate_bits = AUD_RATE_DAC_8K;  break;
577	      case 48000: rate_bits = AUD_RATE_DAC_48K; break;
578	      default:    rate_bits = AUD_RATE_DAC_16K; break;   /* 16k default */
579	    }
580	
581	  val = aud_getreg(AUD_CONFIG);
582	  val &= ~AUD_RATE_DAC_MASK;
583	  val |= rate_bits | AUD_APLL_SEL;
584	  aud_putreg(val, AUD_CONFIG);
585	
586	  /* ---- Enable DAC ---- */
587	
588	  val = aud_getreg(AUD_CONFIG);
589	  val |= AUD_DAC_ENABLE;
590	  aud_putreg(val, AUD_CONFIG);
591	
592	  up_mdelay(5);
593	
594	  syslog(LOG_INFO,
595	         "[spk] dac init: rate=%d AUD_CONFIG=0x%08lx reg20=0x%08lx reg21=0x%08lx\n",
596	         samp_rate,
597	         (unsigned long)aud_getreg(AUD_CONFIG),
598	         (unsigned long)aud_getreg(ANA_REG20),
599	         (unsigned long)aud_getreg(ANA_REG21));
600	}

625	/****************************************************************************
626	 * Name: pa_gpio_set
627	 *   Drive an arbitrary pin as GPIO output at the given level.  Used to
628	 *   enable/disable the external HT6873 Class-D speaker amp (PA_SD).
629	 *   Selects GPIO (first) function + output-enable, robust for any pin.
630	 ****************************************************************************/
631	
632	static void pa_gpio_set(int pin, int level)
633	{
634	  uintptr_t cfg_addr = BK7258_GPIO_CFG(pin);
635	  uintptr_t fn_addr  = BK7258_SYS_GPIO_FUNC(pin);
636	  uint32_t v;
637	
638	  /* SYS func-select nibble → 0 (GPIO / first function) */
639	
640	  v = getreg32(fn_addr);
641	  v &= ~(BK7258_GPIO_FUNC_MASK << BK7258_GPIO_FUNC_SHIFT(pin));
642	  putreg32(v, fn_addr);
643	
644	  /* AON cfg: GPIO mode, output enabled, drive level */
645	
646	  v = getreg32(cfg_addr);
647	  v &= ~GPIO_CFG_SECOND_FUNC;   /* bit6=0: GPIO mode          */
648	  v &= ~GPIO_CFG_OUTPUT_EN;     /* bit3=0: output enabled (active-low) */
649	  if (level)
650	    {
651	      v |= GPIO_CFG_OUTPUT;     /* bit1=1: HIGH */
652	    }
653	  else
654	    {
655	      v &= ~GPIO_CFG_OUTPUT;    /* bit1=0: LOW  */
656	    }
657	  putreg32(v, cfg_addr);
658	}

660	/****************************************************************************
661	 * Name: audio_dac_write
662	 *   Poll DAC-left FIFO; write one 16-bit sample when not full.
663	 ****************************************************************************/
664	
665	static void audio_dac_write(int16_t sample)
666	{
667	  uint32_t spin = 0;
668	
669	  while (aud_getreg(AUD_FIFO_STATUS) & AUD_DACL_FIFO_FULL)
670	    {
671	      if (++spin >= TOTAL_SPIN_CAP)
672	        {
673	          break;   /* safety: never hang the shell */
674	        }
675	    }
676	
677	  aud_putreg((uint32_t)(uint16_t)sample, AUD_DAC_FIFO_PORT);
678	}

680	/****************************************************************************
681	 * Name: audio_beep
682	 *   Play a sine tone through the speaker (polling data pump).
683	 *   freq_hz: 50..4000, ms: 10..5000.  Bring-up test for M2c.
684	 ****************************************************************************/
685	
686	int audio_beep(int freq_hz, int ms, int pa_gpio)
687	{
688	  const int fs = 16000;
689	  const int16_t amp = 8000;          /* ~ -12 dBFS, safe level */
690	  static int16_t period[320];        /* fs/50 = 320 max */
691	  int plen;
692	  long total;
693	  long i;
694	
695	  if (freq_hz < 50)   freq_hz = 50;
696	  if (freq_hz > 4000) freq_hz = 4000;
697	  if (ms < 10)   ms = 10;
698	  if (ms > 5000) ms = 5000;
699	
700	  plen = fs / freq_hz;
701	  if (plen < 4)   plen = 4;
702	  if (plen > 320) plen = 320;
703	
704	  for (i = 0; i < plen; i++)
705	    {
706	      float ph = 2.0f * 3.1415926f * (float)i / (float)plen;
707	      period[i] = (int16_t)((float)amp * sinf(ph));
708	    }
709	
710	  audio_dac_init(fs);
711	
712	  /* Enable external Class-D PA (HT6873) — active high.  pa_gpio < 0 skips. */
713	
714	  if (pa_gpio >= 0)
715	    {
716	      pa_gpio_set(pa_gpio, 1);
717	      up_mdelay(10);   /* PA turn-on settling */
718	      syslog(LOG_INFO, "[spk] PA enable: P%d = HIGH\n", pa_gpio);
719	    }
720	
721	  total = (long)fs * ms / 1000;
722	
723	  syslog(LOG_INFO, "[spk] beep %d Hz, %d ms (%ld samples, period=%d)\n",
724	         freq_hz, ms, total, plen);
725	
726	  for (i = 0; i < total; i++)
727	    {
728	      audio_dac_write(period[i % plen]);
729	    }
730	
731	  for (i = 0; i < 256; i++)
732	    {
733	      audio_dac_write(0);
734	    }
735	
736	  if (pa_gpio >= 0)
737	    {
738	      pa_gpio_set(pa_gpio, 0);   /* PA shutdown */
739	    }
740	
741	  audio_dac_deinit();
742	
743	  syslog(LOG_INFO, "[spk] beep done\n");
744	  return 0;
745	}

747	/****************************************************************************
748	 * Name: audio_play_melody
749	 *   Play a short note sequence (polling).  freqs[i]=0 → rest.
750	 *   Reuses the beep DAC path; blocks for the total duration (~sum of durs).
751	 *   For VelaPet emotion cues (wake/happy).  pa_gpio: HT6873 enable (P50).
752	 ****************************************************************************/
753	
754	int audio_play_melody(const uint16_t *freqs, const uint16_t *durs_ms,
755	                      int n, int pa_gpio)
756	{
757	  const int fs = 16000;
758	  const int16_t amp = 8000;
759	  static int16_t period[320];
760	  int i;
761	  long k;
762	
763	  audio_dac_init(fs);
764	
765	  if (pa_gpio >= 0)
766	    {
767	      pa_gpio_set(pa_gpio, 1);
768	      up_mdelay(10);
769	    }
770	
771	  for (i = 0; i < n; i++)
772	    {
773	      int f  = freqs[i];
774	      int ms = durs_ms[i];
775	      long total = (long)fs * ms / 1000;
776	      int plen;
777	
778	      if (f <= 0)                       /* rest */
779	        {
780	          for (k = 0; k < total; k++) audio_dac_write(0);
781	          continue;
782	        }
783	
784	      if (f < 50)   f = 50;
785	      if (f > 4000) f = 4000;
786	      plen = fs / f;
787	      if (plen < 4)   plen = 4;
788	      if (plen > 320) plen = 320;
789	
790	      for (k = 0; k < plen; k++)
791	        {
792	          period[k] = (int16_t)((float)amp *
793	                        sinf(2.0f * 3.1415926f * (float)k / (float)plen));
794	        }
795	
796	      for (k = 0; k < total; k++)
797	        {
798	          audio_dac_write(period[k % plen]);
799	        }
800	    }
801	
802	  for (k = 0; k < 256; k++) audio_dac_write(0);   /* flush tail */
803	
804	  if (pa_gpio >= 0)
805	    {
806	      pa_gpio_set(pa_gpio, 0);
807	    }
808	
809	  audio_dac_deinit();
810	  return 0;
811	}

814	 * Name: audio_capture
815	 *
816	 * Description:

967	 *   Algorithm:
968	 *     a) Remove DC offset (subtract per-channel mean).
969	 *     b) Compute RMS on original signal for energy gate.
970	 *     c) Pre-emphasis whitening: Ld[i] = L[i] - L[i-1] (first-order HP).
971	 *     d) Cross-correlation on whitened signal, lag d ∈ [-D, +D].
972	 *     e) Parabolic interpolation around peak for sub-sample τ.
973	 *     f) Map: |τ| < TAU_DEAD → center; else ±22 by sign.

975	 ****************************************************************************/

977	int mic_locate_process(int n, int *out_tau_q8)
978	{
979	  int i;
980	  int d;
981	  int best_d = 0;
982	  int32_t mean_l = 0;
983	  int32_t mean_r = 0;
984	  int64_t energy_l = 0;
985	  int64_t energy_r = 0;
986	  int16_t rms_l;
987	  int16_t rms_r;
988	  int32_t best_corr;
989	  int32_t corr_prev;
990	  int32_t corr_best;
991	  int32_t corr_next;
992	  int32_t tau_q8;
993	  int dx;
994	  int nd; /* length after differentiation */
995	
996	  /* Scratch buffers for whitened signal (on stack, 4096*2*2 = 16KB) */
997	
998	  static int16_t g_ld[MIC_N_SAMPLES];
999	  static int16_t g_rd[MIC_N_SAMPLES];
1000	
1001	  if (n < 64)
1002	    {
1003	      syslog(LOG_ERR, "[hear] capture too short: %d\n", n);
1004	      if (out_tau_q8)
1005	        {
1006	          *out_tau_q8 = 0;
1007	        }
1008	
1009	      return DX_CENTER;
1010	    }
1011	
1012	  /* a) Remove DC offset — compute mean then subtract */
1013	
1014	  for (i = 0; i < n; i++)
1015	    {
1016	      mean_l += g_mic_left[i];
1017	      mean_r += g_mic_right[i];
1018	    }
1019	
1020	  mean_l /= n;
1021	  mean_r /= n;
1022	
1023	  for (i = 0; i < n; i++)
1024	    {
1025	      g_mic_left[i]  = (int16_t)(g_mic_left[i]  - mean_l);
1026	      g_mic_right[i] = (int16_t)(g_mic_right[i] - mean_r);
1027	    }
1028	
1029	  /* b) Compute RMS on original (post-DC) signal for energy gate.
1030	   *    Use int64_t to prevent overflow on loud signals.
1031	   */
1032	
1033	  for (i = 0; i < n; i++)
1034	    {
1035	      int32_t sl = g_mic_left[i];
1036	      int32_t sr = g_mic_right[i];
1037	
1038	      energy_l += (int64_t)sl * sl;
1039	      energy_r += (int64_t)sr * sr;
1040	    }
1041	
1042	  /* Integer RMS: sqrt(energy/n).  Use shift-approx for speed. */
1043	
1044	  {
1045	    int32_t vl = (int32_t)(energy_l / n);
1046	    int32_t vr = (int32_t)(energy_r / n);
1047	    int16_t rl = 0;
1048	    int16_t rr = 0;
1049	    int bit;
1050	
1051	    for (bit = 15; bit >= 0; bit--)
1052	      {
1053	        int32_t t;
1054	
1055	        t = rl + (1 << bit);
1056	        if (t * t <= vl)
1057	          {
1058	            rl = (int16_t)t;
1059	          }
1060	
1061	        t = rr + (1 << bit);
1062	        if (t * t <= vr)
1063	          {
1064	            rr = (int16_t)t;
1065	          }
1066	      }
1067	
1068	    rms_l = rl;
1069	    rms_r = rr;
1070	  }
1071	
1072	  syslog(LOG_INFO,
1073	         "[hear] RMS: L=%d R=%d (gate=%d)\n",
1074	         rms_l, rms_r, RMS_GATE);
1075	
1076	  /* Validity: BOTH channels must exceed threshold.
1077	   * If either is too low the cross-correlation is meaningless
1078	   * (e.g. one mic dead or signal off-axis) → report center.
1079	   */
1080	
1081	  if (rms_l < RMS_GATE || rms_r < RMS_GATE)
1082	    {
1083	      syslog(LOG_INFO,
1084	             "[hear] signal insufficient (L=%d R=%d) → center\n",
1085	             rms_l, rms_r);
1086	      if (out_tau_q8)
1087	        {
1088	          *out_tau_q8 = 0;
1089	        }
1090	
1091	      return DX_CENTER;
1092	    }
1093	
1094	  /* c) Pre-emphasis whitening: first-order difference high-pass.
1095	   *    Ld[i] = L[i] - L[i-1],  Rd[i] = R[i] - R[i-1]  (i from 1)
1096	   *    Suppresses low-freq / common-mode, sharpens transient peaks.
1097	   *    Cross-correlation uses whitened signal; RMS gate uses original.
1098	   */
1099	
1100	  nd = n - 1;
1101	  for (i = 1; i < n; i++)
1102	    {
1103	      g_ld[i - 1] = (int16_t)(g_mic_left[i]  - g_mic_left[i  - 1]);
1104	      g_rd[i - 1] = (int16_t)(g_mic_right[i] - g_mic_right[i - 1]);
1105	    }
1106	
1107	  /* d) Cross-correlation on whitened signal,
1108	   *    lag d ∈ [-CORR_LAG_MAX, +CORR_LAG_MAX]
1109	   *    acc is int64 to prevent overflow on loud signals.
1110	   *    No per-frame energy normalisation (constant across lags,
1111	   *    doesn't affect argmax, and was causing overflow).
1112	   */
1113	
1114	  best_corr = 0;
1115	  best_d = 0;
1116	
1117	  for (d = -CORR_LAG_MAX; d <= CORR_LAG_MAX; d++)
1118	    {
1119	      int64_t acc = 0;
1120	      int start;
1121	      int end;
1122	      int idx;
1123	
1124	      /* Valid overlap: i ∈ [max(0,d), min(nd, nd+d)) */
1125	
1126	      start = (d > 0) ? d : 0;
1127	      end   = (d > 0) ? nd : nd + d;
1128	
1129	      for (idx = start; idx < end; idx++)
1130	        {
1131	          acc += (int64_t)g_ld[idx] *
1132	                 (int64_t)g_rd[idx - d];
1133	        }
1134

1136	        {

1138	          best_d = d;
1139	        }
1140	    }

1144	         best_d);
1145	
1146	  /* e) Parabolic interpolation: fit parabola to (d*-1, d*, d*+1)
1147	   *    τ_frac = (c[0] - c[2]) / (2 * (c[0] - 2*c[1] + c[2]))
1148	   *    Clamp τ_frac to [-1, +1] to reject wild extrapolation.
1149	   *    If denominator ≈ 0 or result out of range, fall back to d*.
1150	   *    Result in Q8 fixed-point.
1151	   */
1152	
1153	  {
1154	    int64_t c[3]; /* c[0]=corr(d*-1), c[1]=corr(d*), c[2]=corr(d*+1) */
1155	    int64_t num;
1156	    int64_t den;
1157	    int64_t frac_q8;
1158	
1159	    for (i = 0; i < 3; i++)
1160	      {
1161	        int dd = best_d - 1 + i;
1162	        int64_t acc = 0;
1163	        int start2;
1164	        int end2;
1165	        int idx2;
1166	
1167	        start2 = (dd > 0) ? dd : 0;
1168	        end2   = (dd > 0) ? nd : nd + dd;
1169	
1170	        for (idx2 = start2; idx2 < end2; idx2++)
1171	          {
1172	            acc += (int64_t)g_ld[idx2] *
1173	                   (int64_t)g_rd[idx2 - dd];
1174	          }
1175	
1176	        c[i] = acc;
1177	      }
1178	
1179	    corr_prev = (int32_t)c[0];
1180	    corr_best = (int32_t)c[1];
1181	    corr_next = (int32_t)c[2];
1182	
1183	    /* Parabolic interpolation for sub-sample estimate */
1184	
1185	    num = c[0] - c[2];               /* numerator */
1186	    den = c[0] - 2 * c[1] + c[2];   /* denominator (×2 already in formula) */
1187	
1188	    if (den != 0 && (den > 0 ? den : -den) > (num > 0 ? num : -num) / 4)
1189	      {
1190	        /* frac_q8 = (num << 8) / (2 * den), clamped to [-256, +256] */
1191	
1192	        frac_q8 = (num << 8) / (2 * den);
1193	
1194	        if (frac_q8 < -256)
1195	          {
1196	            frac_q8 = -256;
1197	          }
1198	
1199	        if (frac_q8 > 256)
1200	          {
1201	            frac_q8 = 256;
1202	          }
1203	
1204	        tau_q8 = (int32_t)best_d * 256 + (int32_t)frac_q8;
1205	      }
1206	    else
1207	      {
1208	        /* Flat top or degenerate — use integer lag directly */
1209	
1210	        tau_q8 = (int32_t)best_d * 256;
1211	      }
1212	  }
1213	
1214	  syslog(LOG_INFO,
1215	         "[hear] tau_q8=%ld (%.2f samples)\n",
1216	         (long)tau_q8, (double)tau_q8 / 256.0);
1217	
1218	  /* f) Map to direction */
1219	
1220	  if (tau_q8 < -TAU_DEAD_Q8)
1221	    {
1222	      dx = DX_LEFT;
1223	    }
1224	  else if (tau_q8 > TAU_DEAD_Q8)

1226	      dx = DX_RIGHT;
1227	    }
1228	  else
1229	    {
1230	      dx = DX_CENTER;
1231	    }

1233	  syslog(LOG_INFO,
1234	         "[hear] direction: %s (dx=%d)\n",
1235	         dx < 0 ? "LEFT" : dx > 0 ? "RIGHT" : "CENTER",
1236	         dx);
1237	
1238	  if (out_tau_q8)
1239	    {
1240	      *out_tau_q8 = (int)tau_q8;
1241	    }
1242	
1243	  return dx;
1244	}

# claude_camera_r17.txt — mic test PCM self-test command

## What changed (r17)

Added `mic test [N]` CLI command to `bk7258_audio.c` that captures 16 kHz
mono PCM from the onboard MEMS microphone for N seconds (default 1, max 1),
then prints sample rate, sample count, integer RMS, peak amplitude, and the
first 16 raw samples.

### File: board/contest_board/src/bk7258_audio.c

1. Added `#include <stdlib.h>` for `atoi()`.

2. Added defines after MIC_N_SAMPLES:
   ```c
   #define MIC_TEST_RATE         16000
   #define MIC_TEST_MAX_SEC      1       /* SRAM budget: 16 kHz × 1 s = 32 KB */
   #define MIC_TEST_MAX_SAMPLES  (MIC_TEST_RATE * MIC_TEST_MAX_SEC)
   ```

3. Added static buffer:
   ```c
   static int16_t g_mic_test_pcm[MIC_TEST_MAX_SAMPLES];
   ```

4. Added `mic_test_pcm(int seconds)` function (static, ~115 lines):
   - Calls `audio_init()` (power domain + APLL + analog bias + mic enables)
   - Re-programs AUD_CONFIG rate bits from 48 kHz → 16 kHz (AUD_RATE_ADC_16K)
   - Poll-captures into `g_mic_test_pcm[]` using AUD_FIFO_STATUS / AUD_ADC_FIFO_PORT
   - Computes integer RMS (isqrt via bit-trial) and peak absolute value
   - Prints: sample_rate, samples, duration_ms, RMS, peak, first 16 samples
   - Calls `audio_deinit()` to power down

5. Updated `bk7258_mic_main()` to dispatch:
   - `mic test [N]` → `mic_test_pcm(sec)`
   - `mic` (no args) → legacy `mic_test()` (dual-channel 48 kHz RMS)

### Why max 1 second?

The board's SRAM region is tight.  A 5-second capture at 16 kHz would need
80 000 × 2 = 160 KB of BSS, overflowing sram by ~68 KB.  1 second needs
32 KB and links cleanly.

### Usage

```
nsh> mic test           # 1-second capture (default)
nsh> mic test 1         # same
```

Expected output:
```
[mic] test: rate=16000 Hz, capturing 16000 samples (1 s) ...
[mic] test result:
  sample_rate = 16000 Hz
  samples     = 16000
  duration    = 1000 ms
  RMS         = 123
  peak        = 456
[mic] first 16 samples:
  [ 0]    123
  [ 1]    130
  ...
```

### How to verify

- Quiet room: RMS < 50, peak < 500
- Speak into mic: RMS > 200, peak > 2000
- Samples should NOT be all zeros or all the same value
